narrative:
Sport Holding's hybrid model means intercompany is not a back-office detail. NOK 112.2M sits between the holding company and the locally owned Intersport, Sport 1 and Anton Sport stores and the web business. Store owners have confirmed NOK 100.7M of it; NOK 11.5M is still open.

Intersport carries NOK 6.1M of the open balance. It is almost all central-warehouse deliveries shipped on 31 October and received in store on 2 November. Sport 1's NOK 4.7M is mainly joint marketing-fund contributions that member stores book a month later than the group.

The agent prepares a confirmation pack per store owner: the open items, the evidence (delivery notes, credit memos) and a proposed entry. Agreement takes hours, not the WD+7 chase seen in September.

signals.title: Hybrid ownership — store-owner settlement
signals.excerpt: Intersport and Sport 1 stores are partly owned by local store owners. Group invoices goods, marketing fund and services; balances must be agreed store by store before consolidation.

signals.title: Winter season build — inbound plan
signals.excerpt: Alpine, cross-country and outerwear inbound peaks in October ahead of November and December trading. GRNI and rebate accruals are largest in this window.
